output.semantics: One 128-dimensional face embedding from the upstream INT8-quantised SFace weights. The ONNX graph retains the float32 external tensor contract used by the baseline adapter. Input follows OpenCV FaceRecognizerSF preprocessing: aligned BGR pixels are converted to RGB float32 without scaling or mean subtraction. The application adapter L2-normalises the output before persistence and comparison.

trainingData.notes: The upstream model documentation describes MobileFaceNet instances trained with SFace loss. Review source-dataset terms before model training or redistribution.
